column1: # The reference's logfmt decoder over every field of TOKS alone and every ordered pair
# (pkg/logql/log/logfmt/decode.go, ported). ok = read with no error, no field directly
# followed by a byte above ' ', every key printable ASCII; f<n> = the raw text of each field
# whose sanitised key is in set n, joined by one space. Sets: [["level"], ["_1x", "a_b", "level", "level_extracted"], ["__error__", "b_c", "level", "lvl", "msg"]]
